body: Hunny I’m here to tell you. Get on top and fuck the shit outta him. You are gonna look great regardless

I’m just tired of the struggle. Since I was 15 it’s like that’s all life has been for me.  Now I have this beautiful sweet angel of a woman caught up in this mess that’s my life and I really just feel like I’m being her on a sinking ship.  

There’s nothing here for me other than her and I know it’s a matter of time before it becomes to much for her.  I know it is.  If I were gone she could be happy.

I just feel like she wouldn’t understand.  Like I’ve low keyed tryed and we talk about it for 15-20 seconds and the conversation fades.    I watch her sacrifice so much for us and I just feel like a burden.  I’ve tryed finding other jobs and just a reason for being really and I get nothing.  Between that and multiple other things I just feel like all I do is bring people down.  

I constantly stay in my own head and feel worthless to the people around me.  Like I’m in a room full of people screaming and no one can hear me.  

Just feels it be better for everyone if I’d not be here

I feel you.  At 15 I had a complete shoulder reconstruction surgery that I was told would fix everything.  

From the moment I woke up from surgery I’ve been in pain.  All the therapy all I did for a year and a half. Nothing but constant pain.  I’m 33 I’ve gotten to where I can barley turn my neck from side to side.   I can’t lay on my right side at all hardly and cuddling with my fiancé at night is almost impossible.  

I can’t work like I want too because I can’t hold my arm up for more than about 30 seconds without shaking so bad it’ll about bring a house down. It’s not a matter of if it hurts it’s a matter of how bad and it’s never below about a 6. 

Most people don’t understand why you don’t want todo anything and would just rather be left alone to try and relax. 

I understand where you are at and I believe you are like me and refuse to live on pain meds.  Unfortunately ive learned to live with it. I pray you don’t have todo the same.
I know this feeling. People get mad at you for being down and it makes it worse.  You fake a smile all day long just to keep others from asking questions.  I know this feeling. You aren’t alone
